Q1.rationale: Segment 45 limits use of Confidential Information solely to the Transaction and bars any other purpose without consent.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: No reverse engineering prohibition appears; segment 54 only bars using or testing products embodying CI, which is not reverse engineering.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Segments 72-75 impose 24- and 36-month post-termination obligations and segment 78 keeps the duty in effect indefinitely.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Segment 46 states that no other right or license in the Confidential Information is granted.
Q4.label: Entailment

Q5.rationale: Segment 25 defines CI as covering information in tangible or intangible form, whenever and however disclosed, which includes oral disclosure.
Q5.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: Segment 71 and the cross-reference in segment 35 to paragraph 6 imply a protective-order process, but no explicit duty to notify the Disclosing Party appears in the text.
Q9.label: NotMentioned

Q10.rationale: Segment 38 allows disclosure to directors, officers, employees, agents or representatives with a need to know; consultants and professional advisors are not named.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: Segments 67 and 68 carve out information received from a third party without breach and information independently developed, which recognises acquiring similar information.
Q11.label: Entailment

Q12.rationale: The only monetary remedy is recovery of costs and reasonable attorneys' fees (segment 83); no fixed penalty or liquidated damages appear.
Q12.label: NotMentioned

Q14.rationale: Segment 25 defines CI to include any information however disclosed and segment 34 covers information reasonably recognised as confidential, which is incompatible with a requirement that all CI be expressly identified.
Q14.label: Contradiction

Q15.rationale: Segment 60 bars duplicating tangible CI except for purposes of the Agreement, which permits copying in that circumstance.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Personal identifiable information is CI (segment 29), use is limited to the Transaction (segment 45), and reasonable care and efforts apply to protection (segments 39, 56).
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segment 38 permits sharing CI with the Receiving Party's employees who need to know it for the Transaction.
Q17.label: Entailment

Q18.rationale: No non-solicitation covenant appears in the NDA.
Q18.label: NotMentioned

Q19.rationale: Segment 61 bars disclosing CI to any government agency or regulator without the Disclosing Party's consent; the only carve-out (segment 35) covers disclosure required by law, not voluntary reports of suspected violations.
Q19.label: Entailment

Q20.rationale: The NDA contains no notice of immunity for confidential disclosure of trade secrets to government officials or attorneys.
Q20.label: NotMentioned

Q21.rationale: The NDA contains no notice of the immunity for confidential trade secret disclosures to government officials or attorneys.
Q21.label: NotMentioned

Q22.rationale: The NDA does not mention sexual harassment or sexual assault at all.
Q22.label: NotMentioned

Q23.rationale: No fixed sum or penalty is payable on breach; remedies are injunctive relief and recovery of costs and fees (segments 81-83).
Q23.label: NotMentioned
